title: Virtual Screening and Characterization of AN-329/11627212 as a Novel Inhibitor Disrupting the EED-H3K27me3 Interaction.
authors: Zhou, Ning; Zuo, Zhili; Cao, Haiqiong; Tian, Chengwen; Liu, Yan; Li, Shenghong; Gong, Lihu
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和分子对接发现靶向EED-H3K27me3互作的小分子抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-多肽（H3K27me3）互作，但非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法以对接为主、无AI/物理模拟深度建模，与本课题关联有限。
abstract: The key epigenetic regulator polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2) is dysregulated in multiple cancers. While most therapeutic strategies target its catalytic EZH2 subunit, inhibition of its allosteric EED subunit offers a potential strategy for overcoming emerging drug resistance. Here, we identify and characterize AN-329/11627212, a novel EED-targeting compound, through structure-based virtual screening. Biochemical and biophysical analyses confirm its direct binding to EED. Strikingly, x-ray crystallography reveals that AN-329/11627212 induces dissociation of the pre-bound EED-H3K27me3 complex, consistent with a "hit-and-run" inhibitory mechanism. Detailed molecular docking revealed that AN-329/11627212 embeds itself within EED's allosteric H3K27me3-binding pocket. Functionally, AN-329/11627212 exhibited anti-proliferative activity in PRC2-dependent cancer cell lines, most potently against HCT116 colon cancer cells. Our work identifies AN-329/11627212 as a novel chemotype that acts by dissociating the EED-H3K27me3 complex, providing a foundation for developing next-generation anti-tumor agents targeting PRC2.
abstract_zh: 关键表观遗传调控因子多梳抑制复合物2 (polycomb repressive complex 2, PRC2) 在多种癌症中失调。尽管大多数治疗策略靶向其催化亚基EZH2，但抑制其变构亚基EED为克服新兴耐药性提供了潜在策略。在此，我们通过基于结构的虚拟筛选，识别并表征了一种新型靶向EED的化合物AN-329/11627212。生化和生物物理分析确认其直接结合EED。引人注目的是，X射线晶体学揭示AN-329/11627212诱导预结合的EED-H3K27me3复合物解离，这与“命中即跑” (hit-and-run) 抑制机制一致。详细的分子对接显示，AN-329/11627212嵌入EED的变构H3K27me3结合口袋内。功能上，AN-329/11627212在PRC2依赖性癌细胞系中表现出抗增殖活性，其中对HCT116结肠癌细胞作用最强。我们的工作将AN-329/11627212鉴定为一种通过解离EED-H3K27me3复合物发挥作用的新型化学型，为开发靶向PRC2的下一代抗肿瘤药物奠定了基础。
